rows.text: The Diário do Congresso Nacional reproduces the Superior Electoral Court's diploma, dated Brasília 12 December 2022 and signed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes as President, stating that by the will of the people expressed at the polls on 30 October 2022 Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, candidate of the Brasil da Esperança coalition, was elected President of the Federative Republic of Brazil, and qualifying him for investiture before the National Congress on 1 January 2023.

source_review.result: Unchanged. Every download reproduced the recorded identity byte for byte (24,950,218 bytes, SHA-256 d6c9c275...c854ee), from the origin and from the edge cache, and the raw Internet Archive capture of 9 January 2023 has the same bytes; the text of all 59 pages and the renders of every compared page are identical to those made from the recorded response on 24-25 September 2026 and from the page-range form on 23 September. The compared viewer page-range responses were rebuilt (the two surviving copies of pages 1-8 from CLAUDE-C01-10's check and verification, 4,301,947 bytes each, differ in 38 bytes: Aspose.PDF for Java 23.6 CreationDate and ModDate 09:25:06 against 11:00:05 -03:00 on 23 September 2026, and the trailer /ID). source_review.remaining_gaps: The reviewer's 24,950,158-byte body was not kept and no copy exists on this machine, so which bytes differed cannot be shown, and its fetch time is not in the evidence. This service has returned damaged HTTP 200 bodies before: the CLAUDE-C01-17 verification received 19,397,271 bytes from this URL at 01:34:49 UTC on 25 September 2026 (SHA-256 2bc18af6e3758b2512d2afc3f813f7e2d450497d9ea94bf28192c810ec065977, not a prefix of the recorded file either) and the recorded identity six minutes later, and the CLAUDE-C01-10 and CLAUDE-C01-17 reports record other short Senate transfers. Origin responses are chunked with no Content-Length, so a damaged body cannot be recognised from the headers: a re-download that is not 24,950,218 bytes should be retried, or checked against the raw Internet Archive capture, which serves Content-Length 24950218. The Senate's verification service (sigadweb/v.aspx) was not queried and the QR codes were not decoded; only the printed verification code is recorded.
source_review.independent_review_qualification: Codex independently retrieved the exact current official URL and the stated raw 2023 Archive capture on 28 September 2026 with ordinary requests; both returned the recorded 24,950,218-byte SHA-256 identity. This supports reproducibility of these observations, not an endpoint immutability guarantee. An Age: 0 header alone does not prove direct origin contact. The former d9808101...f6a619 body is unavailable: its differing bytes and cause remain unresolved; it must not be classified as damaged or content-equivalent without the body. Any future mismatch should be retained with headers and UTC before a separately recorded retry. No signature-service or QR validation was performed.
